title: Independent verification: symbolic packed-bit carry table for every even radix
body:
The packed-bit repair count in Hanson Sun / bbMisk's PR1245 depends on a transition table valid at every radix, while its executable digit sweep covers finitely many radices. This independent verification adds a finite symbolic certificate for that already-proved table: every even B>=4, starting directly from the retained literal eight-gate equation. It agrees with PR1245 and claims no new formula, physical supplier or kappa.

Only `research/packed-carry-symbolic/` is added. Each of360 cells supplies quotient witnesses; the checker reconstructs the gate trajectory and verifies12,960 affine inequalities over the unbounded parameter N=B/2, then2,880 signed carry transitions and exact polynomial counts. Negative slopes fail even when all small samples would pass. The generator uses N=4 only to propose witnesses; universal inequalities determine acceptance. No predecessor checker is imported. The proof explains closure, every excluded cell, inactive suffix restoration and the inherited fixed-source product corollary.

Reproduce with Python3.12 and standard library:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/packed-carry-symbolic
```

Expected: `PASS_SYMBOLIC_PACKED_CARRY cells=360 all_even_B>=4 no_new_kappa`, six passing tests, and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

Local validation: Python3.12.13 registered replay and Python3.14.7 optimized replay pass;25,088 complete dirty-field states bind the separate retained simulator; seven gate/certificate mutations, an odd-radix counterexample and a target-only false agreement are checked. Six tests include source/receipt/inventory faults, huge-negative-slope rejection, output preservation and read-only optimized relocation. Twenty research tests pass with one existing skip; selected-record integrity and baseline source binding pass. Hosted CI is separate.

Exact base `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`; PR1245 pin `44bf3b1d6031e4069f5abe26211f15e52293e1f4`. Both heads remained unchanged on final refresh. Full latest overlap covered799 open PR bodies and22 Discussions with complete comment/reply pagination. Assignment seed79, independent-verification track. Claim is in Discussion1166; the selected frontier and upstream files are unchanged.

Credit Hanson Sun / bbMisk PR1245, Precious / Kyu PR773, Aryan Sudhir PR735, and OpenAI's retained manuscript and finite-identity simulator. Prepared for Philipp (@mightyOil) with substantial OpenAI Codex GPT-6 Astra assistance in mathematics, code, tests and writing. Apache-2.0. This is a written proof plus a Python-checked certificate, not a proof-assistant result or independent human review. Complete dirty fields and the original chronology remain required; physical layout, paid correction, native/hosted integration, full supplier cold replay and analytic transfer are outside scope. Open next questions are in the README and TASK.json.
